description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans distributed virtual actor system, specifically testing the prevention of duplicate grain activations under high concurrency conditions. It defines a test class 'DuplicateActivationsTests' with setup fixtures, configuration for silo options, and a stress test method that initiates multiple concurrent calls to target grains to verify the system's activation guarantees.

classes.name: DuplicateActivationsTests
classes.description: Contains setup fixtures and the stress test method to verify duplicate activation prevention in Orleans.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture to configure the Orleans test cluster with custom silo settings.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options, specifically increasing the response timeout to handle high load during stress testing.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Adds custom silo configurator to the test cluster builder, setting up silo options.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Applies specific configuration settings to the silo, such as adjusting the response timeout.

methods.name: DuplicateActivations
methods.description: The main stress test method that creates multiple concurrent calls to target grains to check for duplicate activation failures.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Called on each runner grain to perform any setup required before the blast calls.

methods.description: Method invoked on runner grains to perform multiple concurrent calls to target grains to induce contention.
